access_tier_policy.full_access: required target for production advertiser operation after App Review
access_tier_policy.limited_access: development only / rate-limited; do not represent as production-ready
access_tier_policy.quality_gate: track error rate and API usage before requesting/maintaining access

flow: backend resolves reference at operation time

existing_authorities.rule: Reuse these authorities; do not introduce a parallel token table.

secret_broker_contract.resolution: Resolve the opaque credential reference only after tenant, binding and capability checks; keep the secret in memory for the shortest operation window.
secret_broker_contract.logging: Allowlist structured fields; redact headers, query strings and provider payload fragments before persistence.
secret_broker_contract.cache: No browser cache and no durable plaintext cache. Any in-process cache needs bounded TTL and explicit invalidation.
secret_broker_contract.failure: Fail closed with stable codes; never fall back to another account, credential or Supabase authority.

read_inventory: business_management for business/account inventory as needed
validate_blueprint: ads_management only if Meta remote validation is explicitly authorized

token_policy: No Meta token in DB/browser/log/public docs; store only opaque 1Password locator and readiness receipts.
